intro: Cerellean Whiteclaw is a night elf resting near the docks and inn of Auberdine in Darkshore. Haunted by the memory of his lost love from the ancient Sundering, he struggles to lay her restless spirit to peace.

p: Ten thousand years ago, prior to the War of the Ancients, Cerellean Whiteclaw shared his life with Anaya Dawnrunner. When the demonic invasion tore ancient Kalimdor apart, Anaya perished in the destruction of her city, Ameth'Aran. Stricken with grief, Cerellean followed Malfurion Stormrage into the long druidic slumber, yet the Emerald Dream offered him little respite from her memory. Upon awakening millennia later, he wandered Darkshore in a grief-stricken haze, only to discover that Anaya's ghost remained bound to the very stones where she fell.
